keys.notes: Disable in-game; rely on G-Sync / FreeSync VRR display synchronisation to prevent input latency.

keys.effect: Maximum frame rate limit in Hz. 0 = uncapped.
keys.notes: Uncapped framerate causes GPU thermal spikes and frame pacing jitter. Set to 144 (or 2-3 FPS below VRR maximum).

keys.effect: NCSoft-specific MMORPG crowd and large-scale siege encounter scalability.
keys.notes: Controls simulation budget, mesh LODs, and animation tick frequency during mass player battles. Level 3 maintains high fidelity without CPU bottlenecking.

keys.effect: Texture resolution and streaming budget quality level (0-4).
keys.notes: VRAM-bound. Level 4 (Cinematic) easily fits 12GB+ GPUs with zero compute performance penalty.
Level 4 (Cinematic) incurs high ray tracing overhead. Level 3 provides rich indirect lighting at stable 60+ FPS.
Level 3 provides crisp glossy and specular reflections with optimal frame time pacing.

keys.effect: Virtual Shadow Maps (VSM) and contact shadow quality (0-4).
keys.notes: Level 3 delivers crisp contact shadows while preventing VSM page table thrashing at 5120x1440.

keys.effect: Enables NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution plugin.
keys.notes: Essential for 5120x1440 resolution. Reconstructs image from high-resolution temporal jitter samples with superior edge anti-aliasing.

In Unreal Engine's UDLSSMode enum, 3 maps to Quality (~66.7% render scale), whereas 1 maps to Performance (50% render scale). Setting 3 ensures native-like 3413x960 internal reconstruction to 5120x1440.

keys.effect: NVIDIA Streamline DLSS 3 Optical Flow Frame Generation toggle.
keys.notes: Enables DLSS 3 Frame Generation pipeline for GeForce RTX 40-series cards. Requires Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS) enabled in Windows 11.
Synchronises frame queue submission between CPU and GPU, eliminating input latency in fast-paced combat.

keys.effect: Texture streaming pool size in MB.
keys.notes: 4000 MB budget recommended for 12GB GPUs to prevent texture pop-in during open-world flight and traversal.
Recommended 0 in all goals. On 32:9 ultrawide displays, motion blur severely magnifies peripheral blurring, causing nausea and vestibular eye strain.

keys.effect: Depth of field focal blur quality (0=disabled).
keys.notes: Disabling DoF prevents persistent ocular fatigue caused by continuous eye refocusing across the ultra-wide FOV.
Disabling chromatic aberration removes colour dispersion artifacts at monitor edges.
Disabling film grain eliminates persistent high-frequency visual noise.
Disabling lens flare prevents high-contrast flash bursts from sun sources and explosive spell VFX.

manual_only_settings.location: Settings > Graphics > Frame Generation (or NVIDIA DLSS-G)
manual_only_settings.reason: In Unreal Engine Streamline implementations, the in-game UI controller often initialises Frame Generation from internal profile state. Toggling On in the menu activates optical flow frame generation. Requires Windows Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS).

manual_only_settings.location: Settings > Graphics > Super Resolution / DLSS Mode
manual_only_settings.reason: If the game UI defaults to Performance mode upon first detection, set the dropdown explicitly to Quality (renders internally at ~3413x960 for 5120x1440 output).

notes: Aion 2 uses Unreal Engine 5 with custom NCSoft subsystems (sg.MassiveGameQuality, NCET, NCIK, StreamlineDLSSG).
Config files are stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AION2\Saved_Steam\Config\Windows\ (with Saved_STEAMLST used as secondary/legacy).

For 32:9 ultrawide displays (5120x1440), enabling DLSS Quality and Reflex while disabling post-processing artifacts (Motion Blur, DoF, Chromatic Aberration, Grain) provides high-fps fluid combat with zero eye strain.
